# OWNER DIRECTIVE — ONE POE PORTFOLIO, ONE ENGINE, ONE RENDER REPORTING PIPELINE

**This supersedes the experimental/pilot-account architecture as a target operating model. Implement this consolidation, not another parallel pilot.**

## Non-negotiable source of truth

The sole POE PAPER portfolio is the ORIGINAL account already presented under **Portfolio overview** on the existing Render dashboard:
- Account ID: `poe-3123e352-4581-455b-85db-acd7e825e99e`
- Inception: `2026-10-26T22:07:36.212Z`
- Original virtual funding: $1,000; NEVER seed/fund the ledger again.
- Existing restricted EC2 runtime: `poe-runtime.service`, original application/state under `/opt/poe` and `/var/lib/poe`.
- Existing Render dashboard: `https://meme-machine-dashboard-staging.onrender.com`, service `srv-daqon53tqb8s73bdceq0`.

The separately created `poe-pilot-8468add6-f916-48cf-a585-6cd008a81360` account and the **Experimental portfolio** UI are NOT to be the operating account. **Retire and delete the separate experimental portfolio/account, publisher, and UI after a verified safe account-preserving cutover.** Do not merge its $1,000 cash or its simulated trade results into the original account.

## Verified current architecture and why a UI-only fix is unacceptable

- Production Render `main` has `/api/snapshot` for the original portfolio plus a separate `/api/pilot` channel, `src/pilot-telemetry.ts`, `src/pilot-portfolio-ui.ts`, and `src/dashboard-connections.ts` that inject separate experimental financial/diagnostic panels and credentials `POE_PILOT_*`.
- The advanced trading engine on `poe-free-data-evaluation-20261027` still binds to `poe-pilot-*` in `src/native-paper.ts` and `src/pilot-reporting.ts`, and the native supervisor reads a separate host ledger beneath `/home/mm-ec2-runner/.local/share/poe-native-paper/account`.
- The original EC2 observer/account remains separate; its historic release and $1,000 inception must be preserved.
- The latest source-pinned PAPER lifecycle run `40780989966` ended in a resource-pressure/checkpoint stop after approximately 1089 seconds: no positions or pending actions, nine discovered, 32 reported usable windows, zero evaluated/qualified/orders/fills. Reporting/readback succeeded but autonomous PAPER operation has NOT been accepted.
- Experimental financial state may have durable actions/journals; confirm flat and settled before irreversible removal. Do not confuse a completed/disposable test with a natural trade.

## Required execution — prioritize this single consolidation

1. **Pin and reconcile real identities first.** Read only the actual installed original authoritative ledger, account metadata, inception, current status, wallet/risk state, journal/WAL and Render `/api/snapshot`. Verify original and experimental account IDs/paths against real host state and that there are no active or pending orders, positions, reservations, unsettled callbacks or writer/backup jobs. Preserve original records. Avoid broad re-inventory of retired Meme Machine storage.

2. **Establish exclusive ownership.** Ensure no second financial writer and no concurrent candidate/PAPER service can use the same account. Stop/settle further experimental account runs and dedicated publisher; do not just reconfigure the publisher to label a different account. Maintain original portfolio availability or accurately show maintenance/stale status during controlled handoff. No live-money execution, signing, or funding.

3. **Bind the developed POE trading engine to the ORIGINAL portfolio.** Reuse the original financial account and its history, funds and inception, not the experimental ledger or a newly initialized `poe-*` account. Adapt the existing reviewed native runner, `NativePaper`, `PaperTrader`, `PaperLedger`, reporting projection, supervisor and controlled startup to an exact pinned original account identity. Remove the pilot-only ID regex *by replacing it with an equal-or-stronger exact account/inception/source binding*, never by dropping account checks. If data schema needs migration, implement a one-time idempotent, atomic, recoverable account-preserving migration. Verify ledger integrity, revision monotonicity and no double debits, duplicate fills, SOL/USD repricing of inception or silent historical rewriting. Do not import pilot account balances/trades.

4. **One reporting pipeline and one Render dashboard.** Financial ownership and market intelligence must be projected from the same authoritative POE system. Publish a single coherent, versioned, authenticated `/api/snapshot` source (or explicitly version its single successor) containing portfolio balances, $1,000 inception, P&L, positions, reservations, orders/fills, realized/unrealized/operating costs, candidate discovery/watch/deep status, buy-pressure decisions, refusals, source quality/coverage, HTTP/RPC latency/errors, resource headroom, health, and separate true market/source/report timestamps. Use source-origin facts; no fabricated updates, cross-account stitching, or heartbeat-based false freshness. One controlled bounded publisher, one ingestion identity/credential, one ordering policy, explicit stale and partial-unavailable states. Keep Render as a read-only viewer and private machine POST; no secrets or trading/financial DB on Render.

5. **Make Portfolio Overview the one portfolio UI.** Keep and improve the existing Portfolio overview, positions, recent PAPER trades, P&L chart, strategy/candidate and system diagnostics. Remove the entire Experimental portfolio/Experimental trades presentation and redundant Pilot diagnostics/connection panels. Place useful watch, older-token monitoring, audit, provider and trading-decision information into existing main sections, with expandable details where appropriate. Show one authoritative account ID/source/release and distinguish trading P&L from passive SOL/USD movement. No separate accounts, tabs or fake merged summaries.

6. **Retire and DELETE obsolete experimental infrastructure after cutover verification.** Remove `/api/pilot` as an active ingress/read model and retire `POE_PILOT_ACCOUNT_ID`, `POE_PILOT_INCEPTION_AT`, `POE_PILOT_INGEST_SECRET` and corresponding protected secret/files; remove unnecessary `pilot-telemetry`, `pilot-portfolio-ui`, separate publisher and pilot account files, historical local/cloud experimental ledgers/backups once they are confirmed flat, settled, and no longer required by rollback/retention. Do not remove useful candidate/flow/audit ENGINE functionality merely because its source files historically say “pilot”; rename/refactor where that improves maintainability. Never delete the original `/var/lib/poe` account or its recovery path. Record exact deleted paths and any unremovable components.

7. **Deploy and validate atomically.** Preserve one Render service/URL, don't create another service or account. Verify source-pinned app build/compile/tests and focused integration/restore/idempotency tests. On EC2, prove single writer, original account/inception/cash continuity before/after, original service enabled/restart recovery, PAPER-only safe controls, and that candidate observation plus ledger entry/exit can operate against the same account. On Render verify a single portfolio, one source, no experimental UI, unauthorized POST rejection, wrong-account rejection, duplicate/reordered publication handling, genuine source freshness, mobile UI, and all important metrics available from the same source. Validate actual on-host source versus Render accepted snapshots, with reported gaps (not synthetic values). Use deliberate rollback if any financial inconsistency arises; rollback must keep the original account intact.

8. **Finish as an operational product.** Once unified, continue the existing native scheduler/provider/resource repair work on THIS portfolio, without new test-account architecture. Treat sustained PAPER evaluation/trading, held-position protection, recovery and credible economic outcomes as separate acceptance gates. Do not claim successful trading or 24-hour acceptance until directly proven.

## Acceptance criteria

- Exactly **one** authoritative $1,000 POE PAPER ledger (the original account and inception) and **one active financial writer**.
- Exactly **one** current Render portfolio, with coherent candidate + financial + infrastructure reporting from that same source and one secured ingestion channel.
- No live experimental portfolio, pilot ledger writer/publisher, `/api/pilot` data plane, duplicate $1,000, or user-visible experimental/pilot sections.
- Original account history, cash/positions/pending integrity and PAPER-only safeguards survive deployment, service restart, reporting outage and rollback.
- Experimental files/credentials are removed only after flat/settled/dependency verification; any remaining access/privilege blocker is reported narrowly with the exact required owner action.
- Evidence: specific source commits, tests, host receipts, Render deploy/source verification, removed paths, and clear description of what remains unproven.

**Do not stop at an audit or design memo. Execute the smallest reliable end-to-end code, infrastructure and Render changes with existing authorized tools. No more parallel pilot accounts, no per-step owner approval unless a genuine privilege, spending or live-money action requires it.**
title: OWNER DIRECTIVE: One original POE portfolio, one writer, one Render reporting system — retire experimental account
